description: This file defines the ShapeHolder class, a data structure used within the Android graphics framework to hold a shape and related properties such as position, color, gradient, and alpha transparency. It provides getter and setter methods for manipulating these properties and is designed to facilitate shape drawing and animation in Android.

classes.name: ShapeHolder
classes.description: A class that encapsulates a drawable shape along with properties like position, color, gradient, and transparency, providing methods to manipulate these attributes for rendering shapes in Android applications.

methods.name: setPaint
methods.description: Sets the Paint object used for drawing the shape.

methods.name: getPaint
methods.description: Returns the Paint object used for drawing.

methods.name: setX
methods.description: Sets the x-coordinate position of the shape.

methods.name: getX
methods.description: Returns the x-coordinate position of the shape.

methods.name: setY
methods.description: Sets the y-coordinate position of the shape.

methods.name: getY
methods.description: Returns the y-coordinate position of the shape.

methods.name: getColor
methods.description: Returns the current color of the shape.

methods.name: setColor
methods.description: Sets the color of the shape by updating its Paint object.

methods.name: setGradient
methods.description: Sets the RadialGradient used for shading the shape.

methods.name: getGradient
methods.description: Returns the RadialGradient used for shading.

methods.name: setAlpha
methods.description: Sets the transparency level of the shape.

methods.name: getWidth
methods.description: Returns the width of the shape.

methods.name: setWidth
methods.description: Resizes the shape to the specified width.

methods.name: getHeight
methods.description: Returns the height of the shape.

methods.name: setHeight
methods.description: Resizes the shape to the specified height.

methods.name: ShapeHolder (constructor)
methods.description: Initializes the ShapeHolder with a given ShapeDrawable.
